$comment: Field-level privacy classification of every column the migrations create (ZTAX-PRIV-001 §24, §33; G-PRIV-01; ZTAX-PRIV-REQ-0001 to 0003). migrations/catalog_test.go replays the up migrations and fails on any column missing here, any entry for a column that does not exist, and any entry that is not valid privacy.Metadata: the rules the contract lint applies to API fields. A column is classified in the same change that creates it. The vocabulary is contracts/privacy/vocabulary.json. Columns with only a class are P0.

accumulator_key.note: Opaque key (ADR-0004 §7.2, grammar pending OBL-001). A key that ever encodes a customer identity is reclassified here first.

running_total.note: An aggregate across a tenant's transactions for one key.

subject_id.note: A user id, session id or tenant slug as text; the subject itself is resolved through the audited path.

detail.note: Canonical JSON of what changed. The sign-in record carries user agent and client IP, so the column takes the highest class it can hold. No credential material and no fiscal amount.

user_id.note: Identifies a human principal. Logged as ztx.subject.

email.note: Work email and sign-in handle; carried in Go as privacy.Value.

password_verifier.note: Argon2id PHC string. Not replayable, and still a credential.

source.note: Attribution of reference geography; names a publisher, never a person.

confirmed_by.note: The human who confirmed an AI-sourced classification (ADR-0006 §2.6).

amount.note: One decision's contribution, not an aggregate.

token_digest.note: SHA-256 of the emailed link secret. It sets a password, so it is treated as the credential.

name.note: An operator-chosen label for the ERP connection; not a person.

company_code.note: The legal entity's company code in the customer's ERP.

created_by.note: The person who recorded the bridge.

recorded_by.note: The person who recorded the mapping version.

gl_account.note: An account code in the customer's general ledger.

total_debits.note: A control total across posted TCSL journals: an operator ledger aggregate, not a consumer amount.

total_credits.note: A control total across posted TCSL journals: an operator ledger aggregate, not a consumer amount.

prepared_by.note: The person who prepared the batch.

amount.note: A posted TCSL journal line amount, as exported: a ledger figure, not a consumer identity.

remote_correlation.note: The ERP's own message, receipt or query reference.

erp_reference.note: The ERP's posted journal or document number.

response_digest.note: Checksum of the raw ERP response kept as evidence.

detail.note: Free text entered by the person who recorded the ERP's answer or withdrew the batch.

recorded_by.note: The person who recorded the step.

source_ref.note: The ERP report or extract the balances came from.

source_digest.note: Checksum of the ERP report file.

recorded_by.note: The person who recorded the ERP's balances.

debits.note: A GL account's period activity as the ERP reported it: an operator ledger aggregate.

credits.note: A GL account's period activity as the ERP reported it: an operator ledger aggregate.

ran_by.note: The person who ran the reconciliation; null for system work.

expected.note: A ledger aggregate per GL account.

observed.note: A ledger aggregate per GL account, as the ERP reported it.

detail.note: A fixed explanation the service writes; never free text.

document_number.note: The legal document number a customer holds; it identifies their transaction.

ext_value.note: The customer's own document reference; may be a subscriber account or invoice number.

recorded_by.note: The operator who committed the document; NULL for system work.

source_line_ref.note: The billing system's line reference; may carry an account or order number.

response_body.note: The verbatim response replayed to a retry; carries whatever the fiscal response carried.

boundary.note: Reference geography of a taxing jurisdiction, not a customer location.

amount.note: A per-decision entry, not an aggregate.

name.note: A legal entity's registered name; a company, not a natural person. Reclassified here first if sole traders are onboarded.

assessed_amount.note: A tenant's liability for a period; an aggregate.

recorded_by.note: The user who moved the obligation; NULL when a commit wrote the row.

payload.note: Event payload; may carry decision facts until relayed.

last_error.note: Relay transport error text; the relay records broker errors, never payload values.

token_digest.note: SHA-256 of the session secret. It resolves a session, so it is treated as the credential.

revoked_reason.note: System-chosen text such as 'signed out'; no user input.

user_agent.note: Client identifier, recorded for the admin session list only.

client_ip.note: IP address, recorded for the admin session list only; never used for authentication or situs.

input_canonical.note: The canonical determination input; may carry a natural person's transaction facts.

trace.note: Execution trace (ADR-0005 §2.7); evidence, retained with the decision.

amount.note: A control-ledger amount in aggregate tax terms; carries no customer identity.

slug.note: Tenant handle; may carry a sole trader's name. Logged as-is by bootstrap and sign-in audit, which P1 permits.

display_name.note: Business name; a natural person's name for a sole trader.

reason.note: Free text entered by an administrator.

running_total.note: An aggregate across a tenant's transactions for one key.

threshold_amount.note: A limit from content, not a customer value.

amount.note: One decision's tax assessed into a period's return; an aggregate input.
Tax returned on one decision; a per-transaction figure, not an aggregate.

payment_reference.note: The payment provider's reference for the refunded payment; it can identify a payer's transaction.

reason.note: Free text entered by an operator; may name the customer.

requested_by.note: The user who requested the refund; NULL for system work.

external_reference.note: The provider's reference for its report on the refund.

recorded_by.note: The user who recorded the provider's report; NULL for system work.

url.note: A customer's endpoint. The path or query may carry a customer identifier; logs carry it redacted.

description.note: Free text entered by an administrator.

created_by.note: The administrator who created the webhook; NULL for system work.

recorded_by.note: The administrator who changed the status.

sealed_secret.note: A signing secret, sealed under the cell's webhook key. Never logged, never returned after the response that issued it.

created_by.note: The administrator who issued the secret.

body.note: The CloudEvent as sent; carries what the event's payload carries, amounts included for refunds and threshold crossings.

replayed_by.note: The administrator who replayed the delivery; NULL on a fan-out.

error.note: The transport's error class, truncated; never the response body.

requested_by.note: The operator who submitted the batch.

request.note: A queued commit's canonical request: the same transaction input a decision's envelope records.

recorded_by.note: The operator whose act moved the document; NULL when a correction's commit did.

body.note: The period's sealed population: journal and document ids, control balances, open exceptions. Aggregates, and ids that resolve to fiscal records.

reason.note: Free text entered by an operator.

requested_by.note: The operator who asked to reopen the period.

reason.note: Free text entered by an operator.

recorded_by.note: The operator who moved the period; on a reopening, the requester.

approved_by.note: The second person who approved a reopening.

ran_by.note: The operator who ran the reconciliation.

match_key.note: A canonical id the stage compares on: a decision or refund id, never a customer reference.

expected.note: One decision's or refund's tax as one stage expects it.

observed.note: The same, as the next stage observed it.

detail.note: A sentence the comparison wrote; carries no amount.

resolver.note: The person who resolved the exception.

reason.note: Free text entered by an operator.

evidence.note: References to the evidence a resolution relies on: document ids, ticket numbers.

recorded_by.note: The administrator who recorded the policy version.

matter.note: The claim, investigation or request the hold serves, as an operator named it.

placed_by.note: The administrator who placed the hold.

reason.note: Free text entered by an operator.

recorded_by.note: The administrator who placed, changed or released the hold.

assignments.note: Who holds each role. A party is named by the caller's own reference, which for a customer may be a subscriber account.

matters.note: Forms or matters the grant covers, as the customer named them.

representative.note: The individual or entity acting under the grant.

evidence.note: References to the signed artifact, consent proof or authority acknowledgement.

credential_ref.note: Where the authority credential is held in the secrets vault. Never the credential.

recorded_by.note: The administrator who recorded the grant.

reason.note: Free text entered by an administrator.

recorded_by.note: The administrator who granted, revoked or superseded the authorization.

created_by.note: The person who instantiated the compliance package.

control_total.note: A tenant's liability for a period as prepared for filing; an aggregate.

authority_ref.note: The authority's receipt or reference number for a submission.

evidence.note: The authority's response as received, or the operator's account of what the authority answered.

note.note: Free text entered by a preparer, reviewer, approver or operator.

recorded_by.note: The person who prepared, reviewed, approved, submitted or recorded the step.

source_event_id.note: An identifier in the provider's own billing, usage or GL system.

source_checksum.note: The checksum of the import file the event came in.

source_ref.note: An invoice, usage or GL reference in the provider's systems; never a customer identity.

eligible_base.note: The provider's own revenue base for a fund contribution: an operator aggregate, not a consumer amount (UAT-OBL-025).

excluded_base.note: The provider's own revenue excluded from the base: an operator aggregate (UAT-OBL-025).

exclusion_reason.note: Why revenue is excluded, by rule; not narrative about a person.

recorded_by.note: The person who recorded the contribution.

reason.note: Free text entered by the person who quarantined or released the event.

recorded_by.note: The person who quarantined or released the contribution.

authority_reference.note: The authority's own reference for the matter, as printed on the notice.

amount.note: The figure the notice states for a legal entity, kept as stated; an aggregate, never posted.

linked_case_id.note: An identifier of a related support or legal case, as given.

links.note: Identifiers of returns, receipts, payments, ledger entries, rule versions and correspondence the notice relates to. References only.

created_by.note: The person who registered the notice.

note.note: Free text from the person recording the event: a review note, an escalation question, a disposition.

evidence.note: How a deadline, authenticity, recipient or outcome was established, or the authority's response as received.

authority_ref.note: The authority's receipt, decision or grant reference.

owner_id.note: The person who owns the notice's deadline.

attachment_sha256.note: The SHA-256 of a document recorded as evidence. The document itself is not stored.

attachment_name.note: The file name of a document recorded as evidence, as given; it may name a person.

outcome_amount.note: The figure the authority decided for a legal entity, as stated; never posted.

recorded_by.note: The person who recorded the event.

account_ref.note: A vault or token reference to the payee's account details; never the account number.

source.note: The official instruction the payee details were taken from.

created_by.note: The person who entered the payee details.

evidence.note: How a verification confirmed the details against the authority's official source.

recorded_by.note: The person who verified, suspended or superseded the version.

amount.note: A tenant's tax liability for a period, as instructed for payment; an aggregate.

funding_ref.note: A vault or token reference to the customer's own funding account; never the account number.

created_by.note: The person who made the payment instruction.

provider_ref.note: The provider's or authority's reference for a payment.

raw.note: The provider's response as received, or the operator's account of it.

note.note: Free text entered by an approver or operator.

recorded_by.note: The person who approved, submitted or recorded the step.

limitations.note: Known limitations of the comparator, entered by a person.

created_by.note: The person who recorded the comparator profile.

compared_value.note: Aggregate tax value compared in the run.

absolute_variance.note: Aggregate absolute variance of the run.

created_by.note: The person who executed the run.

comparator_total.note: A transaction's tax total as the comparator computed it.

zoiko_total.note: A transaction's tax total as ZoikoTax decided it.

variance.note: The difference between the two totals.

components.note: Tax components compared, by code and slot, as decimal strings.

note.note: Free text from the person investigating the discrepancy.

recorded_by.note: The person who moved the discrepancy.

created_by.note: The person who created the migration program.

records.note: Historical tax results as the source held them: source ids, document dates, currencies and amounts. The API accepts no personal fields.

control_totals.note: Aggregate amounts the source declared, by currency.

created_by.note: The person who registered the snapshot.
The person who recorded the mapping version.
The person who executed the run.

total.note: A historical document's tax total as the source recorded it.

components.note: Historical tax components by ZoikoTax slot.

note.note: Why an exception was resolved or accepted as a residual.

decided_by.note: The person who decided the exception.

recorded_by.note: The person who moved the cutover.

subject.note: The customer's request in brief. May name people.

description.note: The customer's request as reported. May carry personal data the customer volunteered.

product.note: The product line the request concerns.

legal_entity_id.note: The customer legal entity the case concerns, by identifier.

contract_ref.note: The customer's contract reference, as the customer gave it.

seller_ref.note: The seller the case concerns, when it is not a registered legal entity.

decision_id.note: Read-only reference; no foreign key, nothing written through it.

document_id.note: Read-only reference; no foreign key, nothing written through it.

obligation_id.note: Read-only reference; no foreign key, nothing written through it.

remittance_id.note: Read-only reference; no foreign key, nothing written through it.

assignee.note: The person who owns the case.

evidence.note: References to evidence — hashes or document identifiers — never the evidence itself.

opened_by.note: The person who opened the case; compared with the signer for four-eye sign-off.

note.note: What the person acting recorded: a response, a request, a sign-off or a note.

legal_entity_id.note: The customer legal entity the case concerns, by identifier.

contract_ref.note: The customer's contract reference, as the customer gave it.

seller_ref.note: The seller the case concerns, when it is not a registered legal entity.

assignee.note: The person who owns the case.

evidence.note: References to evidence — hashes or document identifiers — never the evidence itself.

recorded_by.note: The person who acted.

legal_entity_id.note: The legal filer the workpaper is for.

authority.note: The authority the duty is reported to, by name.

materiality.note: The threshold at or above which an adjustment needs a second person: a policy figure, not a consumer amount.

content_release.note: The content or formula release the workpaper applies.

created_by.note: The person who opened the workpaper.

inputs_hash.note: The digest of everything the build read.

output_hash.note: The digest of the build's canonical document.

basis_digest.note: The digest of the preparer-controlled inputs: content release, documented rates and approved adjustments.

output_canonical.note: The build's schedules and reconciliation: a provider's revenue aggregates and references into its own systems, never a customer identity.

built_by.note: The person who ran the build.

note.note: Free text from the person acting: a reason, an explanation of an exception, a review note.

fx_rate_source.note: Where a documented FX rate came from, such as a central bank reference rate.

fx_conversion_basis.note: How converted amounts are computed and rounded, as documented.

adjustment_amount.note: An allowance or adjustment to a provider's base: an operator aggregate, not a consumer amount.

evidence_sha256.note: The SHA-256 of a document recorded as evidence. The document itself is not stored.

evidence_name.note: The file name of a document recorded as evidence, as given; it may name a person.

recorded_by.note: The person who recorded the event.

authority.note: The authority the registration is held with, by name.

registration_number.note: The authority-issued registration number (FRN, 499 Filer ID, VAT number, permit). A sole trader's number identifies a person, so it is redacted in logs and masked in listings.

intake_key.note: The client-minted Idempotency-Key the registration was recorded under; opaque.

intake_hash.note: The canonical digest of the request, compared on a retry.

created_by.note: The person who recorded the registration.

reason.note: Free text from the person recording the event: why it was returned, suspended, revoked or reinstated, or a check note.

check_reference.note: The authority's own reference or receipt for a check, as returned.

receipt_sha256.note: The SHA-256 of a saved copy of the authority's response. The copy itself is not stored.

attachment_sha256.note: The SHA-256 of a supporting document. The document itself is not stored.

attachment_name.note: The file name of a supporting document, as given; it may name a person.

recorded_by.note: The person who recorded the event.

legal_entity_id.note: The seller entity the certificate is given to.

buyer_ref.note: The buyer's identifier in the tenant's own customer system; pseudonymous.

buyer_name.note: The buyer's name as written on the certificate; it may be a natural person.

exemption_reason.note: The exemption the buyer claims, in the words of the certificate.

certificate_number.note: The certificate or exemption permit number; it can identify a person.

product_scope.note: The product families or classification patterns the certificate claims, as written. Never interpreted as a tax rule.

intake_key.note: The client-minted Idempotency-Key the certificate was received under; opaque.

intake_hash.note: The canonical digest of the request, compared on a retry.

created_by.note: The person who received the certificate.

note.note: Free text from the person recording the event: a screening finding, a rationale, a return or suspension reason.

document_sha256.note: The SHA-256 of the certificate document of an evidence version. The document itself is not stored.

document_name.note: The file name of the certificate document, as given; it may name a person.

screening.note: The completeness checklist: PASS, FAIL or NOT_APPLICABLE per criterion. No document content.

recorded_by.note: The person who recorded the event.

subject_ref.note: The caller's own reference for the item, such as a catalog SKU.

reason.note: The reviewer's reason, free text. Never logged and never in an error message. Retention is set by the evidence retention decision, not yet decided.

note.note: An optional reviewer note, free text. Never logged and never in an error message. Retention is set by the evidence retention decision, not yet decided.

evidence_id.note: The Gateway evidence record id for the proposal call. Opaque and optional.

reviewer_id.note: The person who decided, from the session. Never taken from the request.

title.note: A headline for the change, as an analyst or a watcher alert wrote it. About law, not about a person.

summary.note: Free-text summary of the legal change from the person recording it.

source_citation.note: The legal citation of the source.

source_url.note: The official URL of the source, when one exists.

source_edition.note: The edition or version label of the source as published.

source_sha256.note: The SHA-256 of the captured source document, hashed in the browser. The document itself is not stored.

monitor_ref.note: The watcher alert reference a monitor-detected change was recorded from.

source_key.note: Digest of the source identity and version, linking the changes of one source edition.

dedupe_key.note: Digest of the source identity, version and change kind; unique per tenant.

intake_key.note: The client-minted Idempotency-Key the change was recorded under; opaque.

intake_hash.note: The canonical digest of the request, compared on a retry.

created_by.note: The person who recorded the change.

reason.note: The rationale of a triage, hold or disposition, free text from the person deciding.

recorded_by.note: The person who acted on the change.

items.note: The impacted items with their basis: content component ids, and references to the tenant's own registrations and obligations (ids, schemes, business keys, jurisdictions). No registration number and no amount.

created_by.note: The person who ran the assessment.

ai_invocation_id.note: The Gateway evidence record id of the AI call, when known. Opaque.

ai_draft.note: The model's original draft text, kept unchanged as evidence (AIGOV-001 §12).

intake_key.note: The client-minted Idempotency-Key the recommendation was drafted under; opaque.

intake_hash.note: The canonical digest of the request, compared on a retry.

created_by.note: The person who drafted the recommendation.

rationale.note: The recommendation's rationale, free text from its author.

targets.note: The impacted items the recommendation is about, by kind and reference.

reason.note: The reason a specialist recommended, or a reviewer decided or a person withdrew, free text.

handoff_ref.note: The opaque hand-off reference an accepted recommendation records.

recorded_by.note: The person who acted on the recommendation.
